spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mature corn Crop
spec.description: A mature corn stalk rooted at y0, with two golden ears, folded green husks, eight alternating arching leaves and a branching amber tassel. Stepped lance-shaped foliage preserves airy gaps and a recognizable corn silhouette within x2..14, z2..14 and y0..16.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. A mature planted corn crop with botanically recognizable growth: appropriate leaves/stems, ripe edible parts and realistic species-specific plant silhouette in Minecraft cuboids. Airy gaps, layered leaf shapes, leaf veins, natural plant clusters. NOT a generic tomato bush recolored. Rooted at y0, x2..14,z2..14,y0..16. No pot or dirt block. All growth-stage variants will be based on this model.
